notes.title: Raddoll? For Free? In This Economy?
notes.content: you heard it right folks. the hit game, raddoll, has sold over 10 bingillion copies and I am now retiring to a life of luxury with cars and such things. I will also be [b]making the game free to play forever[/b]. that means you can play it and save the money it would've cost to buy it and purchase a $5 Taco Bell Cravings Deluxe Box instead. you're welcome. i just bought you lunch if you think about it.
